```php
<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Bookmark;

class BookmarkPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user)
    {
        // Check if the user is authenticated and has the ability to view all bookmarks
        return $user->checkPermission('view-all-bookmarks');
    }

    public function view(User $user, Bookmark $bookmark)
    {
        // Check if the user is authenticated and has the ability to view a specific bookmark
        return $user->checkPermission('view-bookmark') && $bookmark->user_id === $user->id;
    }

    public function create(User $user)
    {
        // Check if the user is authenticated and has the ability to create bookmarks
        return $user->checkPermission('create-bookmarks');
    }

    public function update(User $user, Bookmark $bookmark)
    {
        // Check if the user is authenticated and has the ability to update a specific bookmark
        return $user->checkPermission('update-bookmark') && $bookmark->user_id === $user->id;
    }

    public function delete(User $user, Bookmark $bookmark)
    {
        // Check if the user is authenticated and has the ability to delete a specific bookmark
        return $user->checkPermission('delete-bookmark') && $bookmark->user_id === $user->id;
    }
}
```
